blocks.text: i) Halogenoalkanes alkanes ki halogenation se, roshni (light) ki maujoodgi mein, banaye ja sakte hain.
ii) Yeh alkenes par hydrogen halides ke electrophilic addition (judne) se bhi bante hain.
iii) Alcohols ko halogen acid (jaise HCl) ke saath react kara kar mutabiq alkyl halides mein badla ja sakta hai. Is mein ZnCl₂ catalyst (reaction tez karne wala madda) ka kaam karta hai.

iv) Alcohols thionyl chloride (SOCl₂) se bhi react kar ke alkyl chlorides dete hain; pyridine catalyst hai. Yeh tareeqa khaas taur par faidemand hai kyun ke zimni products (by-products), HCl aur SO₂, gases hain jo nikal jati hain aur peeche khalis (pure) product bach jata hai.
v) Phosphorus trihalides (jaise PBr₃) ya phosphorus pentahalides (jaise PCl₅) alcohols se react kar ke –OH group ki jagah halogen laga dete hain.

vi) Alcohols ko potassium bromide aur kisi acid, jaise sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) ya phosphoric acid (H₃PO₄), se react kara kar bhi halogenoalkanes banaye jate hain. Yeh tareeqa aam taur par bromoalkanes aur iodoalkanes banane ke liye hai. Pehle acid KBr se react kar ke hydrogen bromide (HBr) banata hai, phir yeh HBr alcohol se react kar ke bromoalkane deta hai.

blocks.text_alt: CH₃–CH₂–OH (ethanol) + KBr + H₂SO₄ → CH₃–CH₂–Br (bromoethane) + H₂O + KHSO₄

blocks.text: Iodoalkanes banane ke liye phosphoric acid behtar hai, kyun ke yeh kamzor oxidizing agent hai aur iodide ions ko iodine mein oxidize nahi karta. (Concentrated sulphuric acid iodide ko iodine mein badal deta hai.)

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq bromoethane qudrati taur par zyada tar samandari algae aur phytoplankton, jaise Trichodesmium, se nikalta hai. Yeh jaandaar samandari paani ke bromide ko urne wale (volatile) organobromine compounds mein badal dete hain. Fiza mein pohanch kar yeh bromine ke aalmi chakkar (global bromine cycle) ka hissa bante hain aur stratosphere ki ozone kam karne mein kirdar ada karte hain. (Aam taur par is silsile mein bromomethane ka naam liya jata hai.)

blocks.prompt: a) Methanol ko chloromethane mein badalne ke do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: CH₃OH + HCl → CH₃Cl + H₂O (ZnCl₂ catalyst); CH₃OH + SOCl₂ → CH₃Cl + SO₂ + HCl (pyridine); CH₃OH + PCl₅ → CH₃Cl + POCl₃ + HCl.

blocks.prompt: b) Propanol ke SOCl₂ aur PBr₃ se reactions likhein.
blocks.explanation: CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + SOCl₂ → CH₃CH₂CH₂Cl + SO₂ + HCl (pyridine); 3CH₃CH₂CH₂OH + PBr₃ → 3CH₃CH₂CH₂Br + H₃PO₃.

blocks.prompt: c) Kya methane aur fluorine gas se fluoromethane banaya ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Amli taur par nahi: fluorine methane se dhamake (explosion) ke saath react karti hai. Qabu mein sirf ek H ki jagah F lagne ke bajaye mukhtalif fluorinated products, carbon aur HF ka mixture banta hai.

items: Alkane + Cl₂ (roshni) → chloroalkane; alkene + HX → halogenoalkane.
Alcohol se: HCl/ZnCl₂, SOCl₂ (pyridine), PBr₃, PCl₅, ya KBr + acid.
SOCl₂ ke by-products gases hain, is liye product khalis milta hai; iodoalkanes ke liye H₃PO₄ behtar.
